**Risk flags:**
- Director 1 holds 57.42% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Delima Pacific Academy Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company providing professional training courses in accounting and finance. It is based in Kuala Lumpur and has been incorporated since 1991‑06‑05 (age not specified in the data). The firm has two directors, with the largest shareholder—a director—owning 57.42% of the equity; the remaining shares are held by other parties. Share capital is RM250,000. Financially, the company reports revenues of RM27,546,638 and a net margin ranging from 5.55% to 7.61% over the last three years, with unqualified audit opinions and current ratios above 1.5.
